summary: Comprehensive testing of Dynasty Dreams NHL fantasy sports platform. Backend: 27/27 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All core flows working - landing page, registration, login, dashboard, league creation, team joining, players page with search, leagues page with filters, drafts page. Mobile responsive design verified.

ui_bugs.issue: Position filter dropdown selection doesn't visually update the dropdown trigger text after selection, though the API call is made correctly
Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent in Join League modal

issues: Navigation links hidden in hamburger menu - this is expected responsive behavior, not a bug

action_items: Consider adding aria-describedby to DialogContent for accessibility compliance
critical_code_review_comments: Auth security verified: /api/auth/me correctly returns 401 without authentication
httpOnly cookies properly set on login/register
Brute force protection implemented with 5 attempt lockout
NHL player data seeded correctly with 1038 players from all 32 teams
All CRUD operations for leagues and teams working correctly

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all core flows working, minor UI polish issues)

seed_data_creation: Test leagues and teams created during testing via API and UI
